booth.name: VAR Booth
booth.text: 94th minute of the cup final. The home side has just scored and the stadium is shaking. The away captain is screaming "OFFSIDE!" at the linesman, a ball boy and the sky. You sit in the VAR Booth in front of twelve screens. Eleven work. The one with the key angle shows only static and a sticky note: "Back in 5 min - Dave". It is your first day.
booth.pundit: PUNDIT: Day one, a missing camera angle and sixty thousand people waiting. Honestly? Best night of my career.

actions.label: Go to the Referee's Dressing Room
actions.text: You sprint down the tunnel, past a confused steward and a trolley of orange slices.

actions.label: Go to the Mascot Changing Room
actions.blocked_text: The door is locked. A laminated sign says: "MASCOTS ONLY. Whistle for entry."
actions.text: You blow the Lucky Whistle. Somewhere inside, a pigeon coos. The door clicks open.

actions.label: Go to the Press Room
actions.text: You follow the sound of camera shutters and bad decisions.

actions.label: Go to the Pitch
actions.blocked_text: A steward blocks the tunnel: "Press conference first, mate. Rules are rules."
actions.text: You walk out under the floodlights. Sixty thousand heads turn. Your knees suddenly remember they are knees.

dressing_room.name: Referee's Dressing Room
dressing_room.text: Steam, muddy boots and a half-eaten orange. A poster on the wall says "TRUST THE PROCESS". The referee left in a hurry. It smells of deep heat and fear.
dressing_room.pundit: PUNDIT: Snooping in the ref's room on day one. Bold. Pointless, but bold.

actions.label: Take the Lucky Whistle from the bench
actions.text: You pick up the Lucky Whistle. Someone has written LUCKY on it in marker pen, so it must be true.

actions.label: Back to the VAR Booth
actions.text: You hurry back to the booth. The static is still there. So is Dave's note.

mascot_room.name: Mascot Changing Room
mascot_room.text: Feathers everywhere. Pombo, the club's pigeon mascot, sits on a bench in his giant costume, head in his wings. He was standing right next to the corner flag when the goal went in.
mascot_room.pundit: PUNDIT: The rookie is interviewing a pigeon. I could not have scripted this.

actions.label: Ask Pombo what he saw
actions.text: Pombo coos nervously and hands you a USB Stick. "Filmed it on my head-cam," he whispers. "For TikTok." The missing angle!

actions.label: Back to the VAR Booth
actions.text: You leave Pombo to his crisis and run back to the booth.

press_room.name: Press Room
press_room.text: A wall of microphones and flashing cameras. Every journalist in the country wants one quote from the new VAR official, and they want it now.
press_room.pundit: PUNDIT: Careful now. One wrong word and you're a meme by full-time.

actions.label: Say: 'Clearly a goal!'
actions.text: Cameras flash. The headline is written before you finish the sentence. Somewhere, a VAR rulebook bursts into flames.

actions.label: Say: 'No comment.'
actions.text: "No comment." Calm. Professional. Boring. The journalists sigh and put their phones away.

actions.label: Back to the VAR Booth
actions.text: You leave the Press Room. A journalist is still shouting questions at the closed door.

pitch.name: The Pitch
pitch.text: Sixty thousand fans are on their feet. The referee holds a hand to his earpiece and stares at you. Both captains are staring too. Everybody is staring. Time to make the call.
pitch.pundit: PUNDIT: Here we go. Decision time for the rookie. I have never been happier.

actions.label: Rule: OFFSIDE
actions.wrong_call_text: You plug in the USB Stick. Pombo's head-cam shows the striker onside by a full metre. PUNDIT: Ooh, the evidence disagrees with you, rookie. Want to try that again?

actions.label: Back to the VAR Booth
actions.text: You walk back inside. Sixty thousand people boo at the same time. Impressive, really.

justice_served.title: Justice Served
justice_served.text: Pombo's footage settles it: onside, the goal stands. Because you said "No comment", nobody can claim you decided before you checked. The home fans sing your name. The away fans sing something else. The referee gives you a small nod. PUNDIT: Fine. Correct AND professional. Absolutely terrible for my ratings.

clip_of_the_year.title: Clip of the Year
clip_of_the_year.text: With no footage, you make the call on pure vibes. The broadcast cuts to your face at the exact moment you decide, and it is not a good face. By morning the clip has 40 million views and its own song. PUNDIT: Absolute cinema. That clip will outlive us all.

right_call_wrong_mouth.title: Right Call, Wrong Mouth
right_call_wrong_mouth.text: Pombo's footage proves it: a goal. But you told the press "Clearly a goal!" before you checked, and now every newspaper says the new VAR official picked a side. You were right, and it does not matter. PUNDIT: Right call, wrong mouth. They'll teach this one at VAR school.
